question: How is the fierce bond from toe upward expressed first by words named after worlds?
premises: Toe and similar points form a binding sequence
The bond is fierce and lord-addressed
World-named words express the first statement
inference: The first noble statement encodes the body binding from toe upward using world-named words.
uncertainties: pādāṅguṣṭhādi may be the start of an upward or downward sequence
nibandhana and bandhana may be near synonyms or distinct technical terms
plain_english: O lord, the binding and fierce bond beginning with the toe and so on—this first noble statement is expressed by words named after worlds.
